name: AGI-Super-Team
tagline_zh: 别单打独斗了，一键拉起你的AI董事会：C-level各司其职，专家随叫随到，还有独立审计，18个平台即插即用。
tagline_en: Stop solo-AI. Spin up a full AI board with C-suites, experts, and independent review—plug into 18 platforms in.
desc_en: An installable, cross-framework AI organization: C-suite agents, expert subagents, curated skills, independent review, and one-command setup across 18 AI client/runtime adapters.
why_zh: 同类多是单点工具，它却把组织架构、技能库和跨平台适配打包成可安装的体系，且自带独立审查，机制完整。
why_en: Unlike single-purpose tools, it ships as an installable org with roles, skills, and cross-platform adapters—plus built-in.
